to
be drilled, completed and produced from the 640-acre units created for the Mississippian

and 65673 7 and the well is located as follows:

The well was drilled

7. 
Reason
Relief Should
Be Granted: 
The drilling
of the horizontal
well
as a multiunit
horizontal
well will prevent
both economic
waste
and a waste of hydrocarbons. 
It is less
expensive
to drill a longer lateral
in a single horizontal
well then to drill two laterals
in two
separate
horizontal
wells. 
In addition, being permitted
to complete
and produce
the lateral
across
the section
line allows
for the production
of hydrocarbons
from
a larger portion of
the reservoir. 
If the completion
interval
must stop as it approaches
the section line and then
restart on the other side of the section line, the hydrocarbons
that are located
in the reservoir
on either
side of the section
line may not be produced
by the wells. 
The common
source
of supply
is approximately
the same thickness
and quality
across the multiunit
area and the
allocation
of costs
and production
based
upon
a percentage
of completion
interval
within
each unit is fair and reasonable. 
8. 
Allowable: 
The well
shall
be permitted
to produce
1OOo/o of a normal
allowable
for the
common
source of supply
named
herein.

9. 
Previous
Orders: Interim
Order No. 721853
is superseded
by this Final Order. 
10. 
Special Findings: The allocation
factor for each of the affected
units should
be determined
by dividing
the length of the completion
interval
from the multiunit
horizontal
well located
in each unit by the entire length of the completion
interval of the multiunit
horizontal
well. 
The completion
interval
of the multiunit
horizontal
well
is located
as follows: 49.48o/o in
Section
35 and 50. 52% in Section
2. The cost of and the production
and proceeds
fr01n
the
multiunit
horizontal
well should
be allocated
between
Section
35 and 2 based
upon
these
percentages. 
Attached
hereto
and marked
as Exhibit " A" is a map showing
the location of
each
currently
existing
well
in
each
of the
affected
units
covered
hereby
and
the
approximate
location
of the multiunit
horizontal
well. 
ORDER
IT IS THE ORDER OF THE COMMISSION that the relief requested in the Application, 
as modified
above, is necessary
to ensure
the greatest
ultimate
recovery
of hydrocarbons
from the above- mentioned
common
source of supply, prevent or assist in preventing
waste, 
and protect
correlative
rights of interested
parties. 
The relief requested
in the Application, 
as modified
above, is granted.
